title: Fix NPE in group-dependency merge and divide-by-zero in coverage bar
target_unit: getGroupDependencies() and getFromDependencyCoverageSvg() in LogicalComponentsReportGenerator (file of 637 LOC, high risk; next to addComponentDependenciesSection(), 53 LOC)
notes: The reference change (+3/-2) reads get(key2) instead of get(key1) in the reverse-direction branch of the group-dependency merge (key1 is absent in that branch, hence the NPE) and guards the coverage percentage against a component with zero lines of code (100.0 * loc / 0 = Infinity, rendered as 2147483647%). The acceptance test builds a synthetic CodeAnalysisResults with one decomposition (components as NamedSourceCodeAspects without files, so 0 LOC) and renders LogicalComponentsReportGenerator.addCodeOrganizationToReport into a RichTextReport, inspecting its fragments (no HTML export, so no Graphviz process is needed): (1) two groups and dependencies g1-a->g2-a (3) and g2-a->g1-b (2) must render without exception and the group graph's DOT must contain one '"Group 1 (2)" -> "Group 2 (1)" [label=" 5 "' link; (2) a dependency with 10 LOC from a 0-LOC component must render '3 files, 10 LOC (0%)' and no 2147483647/Infinity/NaN. Verification: A before = compiles, both tests fail (assertDoesNotThrow reports the NullPointerException; the coverage text is '3 files, 10 LOC (2147483647%)'); A after (commit diff applies as is with patch -p1) = passes, all tests of common/codeanalyzer/reports/cli green (356); B before = same two failures; B after (the one-token fix in ComponentGroupsUtils.getGroupDependencies and the guard in ComponentDependenciesDetailsRenderer.getFromDependencyCoverageSvg) = passes, all module tests green. Lands in A: LogicalComponentsReportGenerator.java (637 LOC / 736 lines); in B: ComponentGroupsUtils.java (87 lines) and ComponentDependenciesDetailsRenderer.java (82 lines), helpers of the now 406-line LogicalComponentsReportGenerator.
